conclusions_zh: 8rank第一collection的chain/oldlogp/clean/请求轨迹/原canonicalmetrics/已存adapterhash与原Safety起点全部一致=True；未重算任何大模型hash。
P1在首256updates的实际aux激活率0.250，历史场景distinct=106；不依赖full103k主流重复当前token。
probe252 P1 weightedaux/PG globalnorm=0.0932，anchor/PG=0.4246；单点未见λ.1极端主导，不称最优。
P1 aux–PG cosine全scope=0.3213、Memory=-0.0183，不能把整体同向说成所有模块同向。
FPO252 anchor/PG globalnorm=0.4783、action=0.6198、Memory=0.2911；该点未压过PG，仍是不可忽略分量。
所有范数是实际source-reduction后8rank平均梯度，不是localscalar loss或localnorm均值。两方法到252θ已不同，不能据梯度大小跨方法排名。
仅过程/启动证据，不是Navtest提分证据；还需正式1k/5k/10k匹配结果，未更改正在运行的任何参数/配置/任务。
P1 native500已完整封存；rank0小文件273KB实际读到bank120/RNGuint8[5056]，与transaction一致；不加载optimizer大文件。FPO500在本次读取时未封存，现已满足双方probe252限定的early证据门槛。

first_collection_material.note_teacher_id_includes_run: Teacher provenance id includes run identity and may differ legitimately;compare actual clean endpoint/requested/metrics bits,not ids that intentionally encode ancestry.

analysis_limits: No deployment/benchmark score improvement is established;no new scoring/model forward was performed.
Each component gradient already includes source reduction and beta/lambda coefficient;do not multiply .1 or50 again.
These are pre-Adam/preclip true globalmean objective gradients,not Adam-preconditioned parameterupdate components.
At probe252 all localPG ranks were active;8otherPG0groups have positive historicalCFM objectives but were not individually component-probed,so their actual auxgradient norms remain unmeasured.

P1 component-sum norm differs0.34% from ordinary native totalgrad at253;FP32/BF16 accumulation/order can differ;retain discrepancy rather than claiming bit-exact gradient decomposition. FPO is identical at this point.
One sparse scene/batch point cannot determine optimallambda or general stability;Memory/scene/predictive aux-PG directions differ.
By252 policies have differenttrainedtheta,so cross-arm gradient magnitude is not an algorithm ranking.
Firstcollection teacher-content comparisons exclude run-provenance identity;raw tensor/requested/metrics are compared exactly,without rehashing modelweights.
